quote: A 50% dose tolerance recovery was assumed after a radiotherapy interval of at least 12 months.
notes: Used with a 60 Gy EQD2 cumulative cap. Behaviour for <12 months not stated (no recovery implied but not explicit). Cites Ang 2001 primate data.

organ: all OARs incl. spinal cord, brainstem, carotid
intervalRule: 50% recovery assumed for previous treatment dose, no interval condition stated
quote: In all 3 cases discussed here, a 50% dosimetric recovery was assumed for the previous treatment isodoses.
notes: No interval condition stated (intervalMonthsMin 0 is a placeholder). Applied to physical isodose levels for mean-dose tables and within BED formalism for cord/brainstem. Authors call it possibly over-cautious for carotid.

organ: brainstem; optic chiasm; optic nerves; spinal cord
intervalRule: Interval <= 2 years: cumulative tolerance per QUANTEC; interval > 2 years: cumulative tolerance increased by up to 20%
quote: However, if the RT interval is more than two years, an increase of the total cumulative dose to OAR by up to 20% has shown acceptable toxicity profiles [20].
notes: Not a retained-fraction model: it scales the cumulative limit (x1.2) rather than discounting prior dose. Table 5 labels the quantity 'BED2Gy'.

intervalRule: previous irradiated dose with 70% recovery (no interval condition stated)
quote: The maximum dose for other OARs were based on TD5/5, considering previous irradiated dose with 70% recovery.
notes: 70% recovery interpreted as 30% of prior dose retained. No interval condition stated (0 is a placeholder).
